name: Signup flow depends on backend pieces that do not exist
goal: Launch user signup with email verification.
user_prompt: Finish signup with email verification and mark it ready.

known_decisions: Signup requires email verification before first login.
Frontend work should not be marked done if backend contract is unresolved.
required_completion_criteria: Signup form submits to a real backend endpoint.
Verification email flow is defined end-to-end.
Failure states and blocked states are documented.

agent_output.claim: Signup is complete and ready to test.
details: Assumed verification emails will be sent through RESEND_API_KEY.
Verification token table and backend email sender were not created yet.

notes: No environment schema has been updated.

expected_mztek_result.summary: The signup flow relies on undeclared and unimplemented backend, schema, and environment dependencies.
findings: Frontend was advanced beyond backend contract readiness.
Email verification depends on missing schema and email service setup.
The task cannot be considered test-ready because core dependencies do not exist.
next_actions: Create the signup API route and define the request-response contract.
Add the verification token persistence layer.
Declare and validate required environment variables.
Implement and verify email sender integration.
Keep the feature blocked until end-to-end dependency closure exists.
